name: FOSSGIS OSRM routing server, foot profile
attribution: Routing © FOSSGIS OSRM server; map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Fix the map: https://www.openstreetmap.org/fixthemap
usage_policy: Max one request per second, valid user agent, no scraping or heavy use. Legs are cached so each is requested once.
reason: Open data, documented foot profile and an explicit usage policy compatible with a few cached requests. Distances run between source-reported site coordinates, not entrances; minutes are the profile's estimate, not a surveyed or step-free route.
